_comment: Clubs that Kalshi spells differently from Polymarket, by hand.
WHY A THIRD TABLE. agent/fixture_aliases.json is Polymarket <-> api-football
and agent/team_aliases.json is Polymarket <-> our own database. Kalshi is a
third vocabulary again: it shortens and truncates where Polymarket writes the
official name, so neither existing table reaches it. Found 2026-09-20 from a
user noticing that FC Porto vs Sport Lisboa e Benfica was on Kalshi while the
board said it was not: the away side scored 0.25 against 'SL Benfica', under
the 0.60 bar, so the fixture failed closed.
HOW IT IS APPLIED. Every spelling maps to a shared canonical key, and two
names match only when BOTH resolve to the SAME canonical. That is exact
equality, not scoring, which is what makes a hand table safe: 'Leuven' can be
aliased without the word Leuven swallowing every other club that contains it.
⚠️ NOTHING INFERS THESE. A scan can suggest a pair but cannot confirm it —
the same scan that found Benfica also proposed 'Fortaleza FC' = 'Chaco For
Ever' at 1.00, because the abbreviation rule lets 'For' prefix 'Fortaleza'.
Every entry below was checked against the fixture's other side, which was
certain independently, and against the Kalshi event ticker's own team
codes. Add entries the same way or not at all.

provenance.method: Scanned the live board for fixtures whose ET date agreed and whose OTHER side scored >= 0.95, then confirmed each pair by hand against the Kalshi event ticker. 16 candidates surfaced; 8 clubs were confirmed and the rest were different fixtures sharing a day.
provenance.measured: 58 fixtures placed on the board at the time, 4 of which were lost to a name the scorer could not reach.
